# ui-skills — ibelick

**Upstream:** https://github.com/ibelick/ui-skills
**Bundled:** `baseline-ui`, `fixing-accessibility`, and `fixing-motion-performance` from the [pinned revision](../../vendors/LOCK.json).

These are short, focused guides. `baseline-ui` applies UI constraints during implementation or reviews a named file without editing. `fixing-accessibility` covers targeted HTML and interaction defects; `fixing-motion-performance` covers animation jank and reduced motion. Use the broader Osmani skills for a full standards audit.

The earlier design-studio copies had duplicate frontmatter in these three files. The refreshed upstream copies have one valid frontmatter block each.

## Invoke

- Claude Code: `/design-tools:ibelick` lists choices; `/design-tools:ibelick:baseline-ui <task>` selects one.
- Codex: `$design-tools:design-tools ibelick:baseline-ui <task>`.
